facts.fact: The CDC Foundation case study says deaths are notified and captured within INRIS, Zambia's civil registration system, with death registration coverage risen from under 4 per cent to 42 per cent; the body prints no date and the published year is used.

The CDC Foundation case study says the expansion of INRIS has brought access to CRVS services to 81 of 116 districts, covering 83 per cent of the population; it does not count offices registering, and prints no date, so the published year is used.

The case study names the Department of National Registration, Passport and Citizenship as the body running death registration and INRIS, jointly with the Ministry of Health for e-death notification; undated, published year used.

The case study says UNICEF and Bloomberg Philanthropies supported the expansion of INRIS, and that partners including the Data for Health Initiative are equipping INRIS kits in select district registration offices and hospital mortuaries; no domestic budget line is stated; undated, published year used.

facts.fact: The UN Resident Coordinator's remarks mark the launch of the National CRVS Policy and its Implementation Plan, beside the 2021-25 CRVS National Strategic Action Plan, and say the policy will complement and strengthen the recently launched INRIS; the body prints no date and the published date is used.

The UN Resident Coordinator credits the Government, through the Ministry of Home Affairs and Internal Security, with launching INRIS and scaling it up, and asks the ministry to convene donors to supplement Government's resources for it; published date used.

The UN Resident Coordinator says the Government scaled INRIS up to over 40 districts within one year of its launch, in a country the remarks count at 116 districts; no count of offices registering is given; published date used.

Statutory Instrument No. 44 of 2016 decentralised birth and death certification to provincial and district levels.

facts.fact: The Eighth National Development Plan 2022-2026 commits the Government to decentralise the civil and vital registration system, including operationalisation of the Integrated National Registration Information System, and lists civil registration and vital statistics automation as a programme under its health information strategy.

facts.fact: INRIS has been rolled out in 79 districts, with all city and municipal councils covered and some district councils pending, per the INRIS deputy project manager.

The Government of Zambia has received International Development Association financing under the Digital Zambia Acceleration Project, part of which the Smart Zambia Institute will apply to the CRVS core modules integrator contract.
